messages.subject: Milkweed seeds
messages.text:
Good morning! 

 Can you please tell me what arrival window we can expect for the delivery of milkweed seeds that I would like to order?

 Amy B
 609 618-2292

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed seeds
messages.text:
Hi Amy,

Milkweed seeds are shipped by regular mail with a stamp, so there's no tracking number. Delivery typically takes anywhere from 5 to 12 business days depending on your destination, so well within your 3-4 week window.

Since this message dates back to March and you mentioned you were only at the campground until April, I want to make sure this is still relevant before you place an order. Are you still looking to get seeds, and do you have a permanent address to ship to now?

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
